record.one_liner: Customer service/support ticketing platform with a broad REST API for tickets, help center, talk, chat, sell, and conversations.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 (Bearer access token) is the recommended method. Legacy API tokens use basic auth format {email}/token:{api_token}, base64-encoded in the Authorization header; API tokens are being deprecated (deactivation April 30, 2027), pushing integrations to OAuth.
record.access_notes: API rate limits are defined per paid Zendesk plan tier (Team through Enterprise Plus), with a High Volume API add-on available for qualifying Suite Growth/Support Professional plans and above. No mention of a permanent free API tier was found in fetched vendor docs; could not fetch a pricing/signup page directly within budget to confirm trial self-serve availability, so access_model is based on plan-gated rate limits rather than a signup page.
record.api_breadth_basis: developer.zendesk.com/api-reference lists many product-family APIs: Support (tickets/users/orgs), Help Center, AI Agents, Conversations, Talk, Custom Objects, Chat, Sell, Status, Web Widget/Mobile SDKs, Apps framework across products, Webhooks, and Zendesk Integration Services (ZIS) — well beyond 60 endpoints spanning multiple product lines.
record.blocker_notes: The REST API surface is broad and well-documented with standard OAuth2/API-token auth, but usage is tied to a paid Zendesk plan (rate limits start at the Team tier); no evidence of a perpetual free tier was found in fetched vendor docs.
